'''Ravin Thiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who worked for the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Aral tukor Viest]]. A small-time criminal, Thiss possessed a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and commanded a crew of about twenty individuals.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
